Path 2, durabilityGOALS §3.7

Cadence

Durable workflows for agents that act over many steps.

WHAT IT IS

An open-source durable workflow engine from Uber: workflow state is persisted, so a multi-step job survives crashes and resumes or compensates cleanly. Temporal is its better-known descendant.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Makes a half-finished multi-step change recoverable instead of leaving infrastructure in an unknown state.

WHERE WE STAND

Watch. It becomes relevant at stage 4, when agents take multi-step actions; not before.

"Agents Fail, Workflows Recover: Durable Agent Orchestration with Cadence", KubeCon NA 2026
